mandatory_safety: Create timestamped canonical DB backup before mutation and record SHA-256.

After regroup correction, import all pending additive GPT-authored semantic inputs without inventing new semantics.
Run integrity, foreign-key, idempotency, focused tests, full npm test, validate and git diff checks before commit/push.
Produce exact before/after manifests and final DB SHA-256.
